# Legacy Dashboard Contract Fixtures

These are synthetic, non-personal examples that preserve selected contract shapes from `UlrichCODJIA/ai-job-search-dashboard` at commit `c4982d87b0b64e87a4f190c1bb933fb565a81309`.

Sources reviewed:

- `web/src/api/types.ts` for the `ScrapedJob` compatibility shape.
- `web/src/api/runTypes.ts` for the normalized run-event compatibility shape.

The reference repository is MIT-licensed. No production record, candidate data, prompt, credential, or generated document is copied here. These fixtures are regression inputs for one-way compatibility adapters; they are not canonical Career OS storage formats.
